rule: Defer-with-Scope thread disposition routes through the sanctioned defer reply path
description: P3 coupling. `plugin/governance/remediation-doctrine.md` is the single source for what happens to the ORIGINATING thread once an actionable finding is left unfixed under Defer-with-Scope: the thread is replied-to AND resolved, citing the tracking issue OR the recorded residual. Exactly one mechanism discharges that obligation — the `--defer` mode of `plugin/skills/github-review-loop/scripts/reply-resolve.sh`, routed by `plugin/agents/github-reviewer.md` — so doctrine, route, and implementation must stay coupled, or doctrine names an obligation with no sanctioned way to perform it. The SOURCE pin sits on the doctrine clause carrying both halves of the obligation (replied-to and resolved) and both admissible citations (tracking issue or recorded residual): dropping either half, or narrowing the destination to a single type, changes what the rule requires and turns the suite red. Four consumer pins, each failing independently. (a) `plugin/agents/github-reviewer.md` carries the route as ONE span holding the discriminating CONDITION — a finding left unfixed per the named doctrine section, whose tracked home MUST ALREADY EXIST, filed or written and not merely named, before the defer reply is posted — together with the OBLIGATION it triggers: invoke the SAME script with `--defer "$TRACKED_HOME"` and an EMPTY fix-SHA positional. Per rule 2 of the pin-authoring contract both clauses are inside the span, because either alone leaves the other rewritable with the suite green: a condition-only pin survives swapping the invocation, an obligation-only pin survives deleting the exists-first precondition. That agent file is the canonical home of the INVOCATION contract rather than a restatement of doctrine prose, and the doctrine POINTER sits inside the same span, so pinning the obligation here does not violate rule 3. (b) The same agent file's raw-mutation ban is pinned separately: it is what makes `the SAME script` EXCLUSIVE, and without it a defer reply may be posted by a hand-rolled mutation that carries no marker. (c) `plugin/skills/github-review-loop/scripts/reply-resolve.sh` is pinned at the `--defer)` flag-parse arm, proving the flag the agent is told to pass still exists under that exact name. (d) The same script's flag body is pinned as a CODE-ONLY span — it sets defer mode and binds the NEXT argument as the tracked home — because `--defer)` alone would survive being reduced to a silently-ignored no-op, and a code-only span keeps honest rewording of the surrounding comments unpunished. What this fixture honestly guarantees is exactly that these word sequences exist in these three named files; it claims nothing about meaning and nothing about runtime behaviour. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a presence pin proves the route is still WRITTEN DOWN, never that a deferred thread is actually replied to and resolved at run time — behavioural proof lives in `tools/test_reply_resolve.sh`; (2) a meaning inversion leaving the pinned bytes intact stays green, so surrounding prose that re-admits raw mutations, or that lets the tracked home be merely named, is invisible; (3) the byte-level coupling between the emitted defer body and the classifier's deferred-marker regex is NOT this fixture's claim — it is guarded by `tests/policy/safety-deferral-reply-body-marker.json`; (4) the pin sees only the three files it names, and a NEW agent or skill that reaches the defer disposition without carrying the route at all is an absence defect no fixture in this directory can detect per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract.

source.pattern: The originating thread is then replied-to and resolved citing the tracking issue or the recorded residual.

consumers.pattern: For a finding left unfixed per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/remediation-doctrine.md` (Defer-with-Scope), the tracked home MUST ALREADY EXIST — the issue filed or the residual written, not merely named — before the defer reply is posted, and you then invoke the SAME script with `--defer "$TRACKED_HOME"` and an EMPTY fix-SHA positional
this script is the ONLY sanctioned reply/resolve path

DEFER_MODE=1
      shift
      if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
        TRACKED_HOME="$1"
        shift
      fi ;;
